ipxact:component.ipxact:name: g2d_top

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: IP identifier, ASCII "G2D ".

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: VERSION
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: IP version (from the version key of this file).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HWCFG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Build-time configuration.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SCRATCH
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Scratch register for bus tests.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Status.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQ_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt status, write 1 to clear.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQ_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt enable (same bit layout as IRQ_STATUS).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CMD_ADDR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Address of the next command buffer to kick (8-byte aligned).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CMD_KICK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Write pushes {CMD_ADDR, SIZE} into the kick queue.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FENCE_SEQ
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Value of the last completed FENCE command.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ERR_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Error flags (arch.md 8). Write 1 to clear; HALTED still needs a soft reset.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ERR_ADDR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Memory address of the first faulting transaction (low 32 bits).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ERR_CMD_ADDR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Address of the command header being executed when the first error occurred.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MEM_BASE_HI
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Upper AXI address bits [ADDR_W-1:32] for all GPU accesses (ignored when ADDR_W = 32).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ADDR_WIN_LO
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Lowest permitted GPU address (inclusive), 64-byte granular (rendering.md 13.2).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ADDR_WIN_HI
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Highest permitted GPU address (inclusive); the low 6 bits always read as 1 (rendering.md 13.2).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CUR_CMD_ADDR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Address of the command word currently being parsed (debug).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DBG_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Debug control (v1.8, arch.md 9.1).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DBG_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Debug status (v1.8, arch.md 9.1). RAM_COLL bit i is set when on-chip RAM i was read and written at the same address in one cycle (undefined data on a real RAM; never happens by design): 0 raster edge buffer, 1 raster state buffers, 2 raster active list, 3 winding accumulator, 4 write combiner, 5 source cache, 6 gradient ramp. Write 1 to clear.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WR_SIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Write signature (v1.8, arch.md 9.1): CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3, as zlib.crc32) over the bytes of every AXI W beat since reset or DBG_CTRL.SIG_CLEAR, byte lanes in order, lanes with WSTRB = 0 counted as 0x00. Not changed by a soft reset.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MEM_ATTR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: AXI attributes of the memory port (v1.9, arch.md 4.2). Used by every burst request issued after the write; a request already waiting on the bus keeps its values. Reset values are the fixed values of v1.0..v1.8 (normal non-cacheable bufferable, unprivileged secure data access, QoS 0).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MEM_QOS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Memory-port throttle (v1.9, arch.md 4.2.1). RD_MAX / WR_MAX: at most this many read / write bursts outstanding (0 = only the build-time limit RD_OUTSTANDING / WR_OUTSTANDING). RD_GAP / WR_GAP: at least this many cycles without a request handshake after each AR / AW handshake (0 = none). Reset = off, which is cycle-identical to v1.8. A request already waiting on the bus is never withdrawn.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Performance counter control.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_CYCLES
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Cycles while EN.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_BUSY_CYCLES
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Cycles while not IDLE.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_DRAWS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Draw commands completed.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_PIXELS_OUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Pixels written.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_RD_BEATS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: AXI R beats accepted.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_WR_BEATS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: AXI W beats sent.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_RD_STALL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Cycles with AR or R back-pressure.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_WR_STALL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Cycles with AW, W or B back-pressure.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_DRAIN_CYC
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Cycles spent in draw-ordering drains.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_SRC_CACHE_MISS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Source cache line misses.

ipxact:component.ipxact:description: G2D 2D / 2.5D GPU IP (VGLite API compatible), Apache-2.0 WITH SHL-2.1. Ports at the default parameters (DATA_W 64, ADDR_W 32, ID_W 4); see docs/INTEGRATION.md.
